newsitem.title: USA: Cable & Wireless to exercise share rights.
newsitem.headline: Cable & Wireless to exercise share rights.

text.p: Cable & Wireless Communications Plc said Tuesday it alerted Bell Cablemedia Plc shareholders who have not already accepted its offer that it now intends to exercise its rights to acquire compulsorily all of outstanding ordinary shares.

The company also said it issued notices to those NYNEX CableComms UK shareholders who have not accepted the offer, informing them it now plans to exercise its rights to buy the outstanding ordinary shares of NYNEX CableComms UK.
Cable & Wireless said its offer for Bell Cablemedia and NYNEX CableComms Group Inc and NYNEX CableComms Group Plc were declared unconditional in all respects on April 28, 1997.
NYNEX CableComms US shareholders approved the merger of NYNEX CableComms US with a subsidiary of Cable & Wireless Communications on April 24, the company said.

Cable & Wireless Communications, the new cable telephone and television company in Britain, has been formed by the merger of the Mercury subsidiary of Cable & Wireless Plc with the three cable units of NYNEX Corp and Bell Canada.
